steps.message: The fix ensures that when `convert_underscores=True` (the default for `Header`), any alias (whether provided explicitly or derived from the parameter name) has its underscores replaced with hyphens, both during the initial field analysis and during the header extraction process.

The bug was that FastAPI only converted underscores to hyphens in header names if the alias was the same as the parameter name. If an explicit alias with underscores was provided, it was accepted as-is, even when `convert_underscores=True`. I updated `fastapi/dependencies/utils.py` to ensure that underscores are always replaced with hyphens in the alias when `convert_underscores` is enabled, both during the initial parameter analysis and during the header value retrieval process.
